$comment: ServerTop LLM servers — copy to llm.json next to the app (Docker: mount as /app/llm.json) and restart. Each entry is probed every 15s. Default probe queries the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models (llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, custom) for up/latency/model/context; vanilla llama.cpp also reports busy slots via /slots. Set "probe": "http" for non-OpenAI services (e.g. WebSocket gateways): any HTTP response counts as up, latency is the round-trip, and the optional static "model" fills the label. Local servers additionally get process CPU/memory via their listening port (needs lsof).
